en.subtitle: Dating that widens slowly
en.short_description: Dating that starts in your ZIP area and widens only when you want it to.
en.description:
Most dating apps open with the whole country and let you filter down. DriftDate does the opposite: it starts where you are and widens only when you ask it to.

—— Layers ——

Discovery expands in steps — your ZIP area, then your state, then everywhere. You choose when to move outward, so "nearby" actually means nearby, and you see your own area properly before it gets diluted.

—— Safety is part of the product ——

COARSE LOCATION, ALWAYS
Your position is reduced to a 3-digit ZIP prefix and a state before it is saved. Raw coordinates are never stored or shown to another user.

TRUST PASSPORT
Confirm your phone number and email, and see exactly which checks are done. Identity, background and financial checks are listed as not yet available, and nothing is ever marked verified that was not.

REPORT AND BLOCK FROM ANYWHERE
Report or block someone from their card in Discover, from a match, or from a conversation. The Safety Centre is one tap from Discover and holds safety guidance and your block list.

BLOCK LIST
Block anyone, at any time. Blocks are immediate and permanent unless you undo them.

—— Matching ——

MUTUAL MATCHES
A match only happens when you both wave. Passing on someone stays on your device and is never shown to them.

DATE IDEAS
Activity ideas drawn from the interests you and a match actually share.

COMPATIBILITY
A read on what you have in common, worked out on your device from interests, intent and prompts, and shown as reasons rather than a bare number.

—— Honest about what this is ——

DriftDate is for adults looking to meet other adults. It is 17+. Meeting someone from the internet carries real risk: tell a friend where you are going, meet in public first, and use the Safety Centre. We verify what we can and cannot vouch for anyone.

en.release_notes:
First release of DriftDate.

• Layered discovery: ZIP area, then state, then everywhere - you choose when to widen
• Location is reduced to a ZIP prefix and state before it is saved; raw coordinates are never stored
• Trust Passport: confirm your phone and email; nothing is marked verified that was not
• Report and block from Discover, matches and conversations; Safety Centre one tap from Discover
• Mutual matches, date ideas from shared interests, and compatibility reasons

Feedback is welcome at contact@americangroup.ai.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Most dating apps open with the whole country and let you filter down. DriftDate does the opposite: it starts where you are and widens only when you ask it to.

Intended audience:
Dating that widens slowly

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. Test credentials are in the demo account fields of App Review Information.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- device location services (on-device)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is in the app: sign in, open the Profile tab, tap the gear icon (Settings), then Account > Delete account. Type DELETE in the confirmation dialog to permanently delete the account; the app then signs out. No email or website is involved.

8. MESSAGING AND IDENTITY VERIFICATION
Messages can be sent only between two people who both have a verified identity. The database enforces this on every message (the can_send_message check requires both profiles to be identity-verified).
Identity verification is not available in this build. Only phone and email can be confirmed (Profile > gear icon > Your Trust Score); the ID, selfie and other checks are shown as "Not available yet".
So when you open a chat and try to send a message, or send a date plan from a match, the message is refused and the chat shows a locked notice explaining that messages need two verified identities and that verification is not available in this version yet. The typed message is kept and nothing is shown as sent. This is the intended behaviour of this build, not a defect.

_account_deletion_note: The in-app Delete account path calls the delete_user RPC. It only succeeds once MA-044 (delete_user migration) is applied to the production Supabase project; until then the app shows 'Could not delete your account. Please try again.' and nothing is removed. Apply MA-044 before submitting for review.
